description:
Buy Xanax 2mg

Buy Xanax 2mg(Xanax XR, Niravam) is an anti-anxiety medication in the benzodiazepine family, which also includes diazepam (Valium), clonazepam (Klonopin), lorazepam (Ativan), flurazepam (Dalmane), and others. Alprazolam and other benzodiazepines work by enhancing the effects of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) in the brain.

The initial dose for treating anxiety is 0.25-0.5 mg 3 to 4 times daily using immediate-release tablets.

The initial dose for the treatment of panic attacks is 0.5 mg 3 times a day. The dose can be increased every 3-4 days, but not by more than 1 mg daily.

The effective dose to prevent panic attacks may be as high as 10 mg daily in some patients. The starting dose when using extended release tablets to treat panic disorder is 0.5 mg once daily and the average dose is 3-6 mg once daily.
